verdict.rationale: Circle documents developer-controlled custodial wallets aimed at payouts, with APIs to sign transactions and send USDC transfers. Generic webhooks fire when a resource changes state, and idempotency keys make retries safe. CPN payouts settle in USDC onchain. However, the pack never shows a payout or transfer endpoint to a wallet address or saved recipient, nor a status lifecycle that runs through to final settlement. Missing for 10: documented stored-recipient or address-book payouts, an explicit payout/transfer endpoint, documented transfer status states through final settlement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send stablecoin payouts programmatically — pay a wallet address or stored recipient through the API with documented status tracking to final settlement
